name: Burning of Magnesium Ribbon Complete Lab Bench Setup
semanticDescription: Complete assembled laboratory experiment setup for the burning of magnesium ribbon in air (CBSE Class 10 Chemistry, Chapter 1: Chemical Reactions and Equations, Activity 1.1). Contains a laboratory bench with heat-resistant ceramic tile, a high-fidelity Bunsen burner with gas inlet hose and adjustable air collar, crucible tongs holding a strip of silvery magnesium ribbon, a watch glass placed beneath to collect the white magnesium oxide (MgO) powder ash, and sandpaper for pre-reaction oxide cleaning.
simplifications: Ribbon thickness is slightly exaggerated (1.5mm) for visual clarity at standard camera distances.
The watch glass contains a collected heap of white magnesium oxide powder representing the post-combustion state.
